en: I am Al'tabim the All-Seeing - an envoy of King Rastakhan.$B$BMy dealings are with priests, mages, and warlocks.
How many of our Commanders are still alive, Drek'Thar?
The Forest Lord is aware of the destruction in this valley, $n. Soon we must make our way to the Circle of Calling. Prepare yourself!
Dun Baldar is in very bad shape, and we're very low on supplies to rebuild it.  The Alliance needs your help gathering supplies!
Accept my thanks, $n.  Yagyin's journal shall be yours.
This is a waste of time, mine and yours! Go see Graham Van Talen if you want to begin your instruction! He's standing to my left over there.
There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.
This isn't a game you toy with youngling! Go, speak with Snarl outside. He may be a serpent in my lair but he does know his way around an anvil.
Wow! We did it... not sure why we thought we needed the likes of you. Nevertheless, speak with Smeed Scrablescrew; he will give you your earnings!
This is quite an adventure!
Our units are upgraded to Seasoned, but I don't have enough supplies to upgrade them to Veteran.
So... you want to be a tailor? Very well, we'll see if you have what it takes.
%s devours all nearby zombies!
Phase 3! <PH>
Death to $n!  Long live the Blackrock Clan!
Um, Ozzie... that doesn't look very safe.
I see you...
I'd like to fly to Thunder Bluff.
Invulnerable?
Guess there's nothing more to be done. Blast!
The strongest hides come from those kodo that have laid themselves to rest in this wasteland.

Hello, $c! I've went around and asked, and it looks like all of us here have collected everything that the Alliance needs to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War. Now we just need to encourage the Horde to do the same and then we'll be able to ship it all over to Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Tips are always graciously accepted, friend.
I'm ready to find the squirrel, Monty.
Aye $g lad : lass; are ye ready to head to Alterac Valley and give the Horde a taste o' what they been asking for?
I am Highborne, $r. It has no meaning now. There was a time, though, when this world was ruled by Highborne. Ten thousand years past...
In this world where time is your enemy, it is my greatest ally. This grand game of life that you think you play in fact plays you. To that I say...
Okay, okay... I'm up.
Davil Lightfire has succumbed to his wounds!
No!  Get away from me!  Help!!
Too many have fallen, $g priest:priestess;. You must focus!
The world will suffer immeasurable cruelties under my reign.
Veteran units are entering the battle!
%s takes his last breath.
